courses.heading: Our Courses
courses.subHeading: ACS Mulinguae provides the following courses:

sectionTitles.esl: 1. English as a Second Language (ESL) - General English (six levels)
sectionTitles.languages: As a promoter of languages, ACS Mulinguae is very keen to look for teachers of any language that you want to learn. Just drop some words in the Contact Box

englishCourses.Description: Absolute Beginners are learners who have had no or very little instruction in the target language. It is distinguished from false beginners who are learners who have studied the target language before but never acquire a real grasp of the language.
LearningOutcomes: Ask and answer simple questions on very familiar topics
Use simple phrases and sentences to describe where they live and people they know
Understand familiar words and very basic phrases when spoken slowly and clearly
Read simple words, phrases, and sentences
Write short, simple postcards and fill in forms with personal details

englishCourses.Description: This course is for learners who have completed level 1 or have already a basic knowledge of the target language. It covers subjects such as definite and indefinite articles, congratulating, giving / justifying opinions, spelling skills, nouns and pronouns, positive and negative.
LearningOutcomes: Communicate in simple and routine tasks on family topics and activities
Make simple description of their family and other people, living conditions, educational background and their present or most recent job
Understand phrases and common vocabulary on common areas
Read very short, simple texts and find specific, predictable information in advertisements, prospectuses, menus and time tables and understand short simple personal letters
Write short, simple notes and messages, simple personal letters such as thanking someone

englishCourses.Description: This course is for learners who have completed level 2 or have reached this level in another set-up. (The learner will sit a test to determine his or her level). The course covers subjects such as the use of the continuous and perfect tenses, passive voice, adverbs and vocabulary surrounding presentation, restaurant and leisure venues, common dishes, personal experiences, weather and climate change.
LearningOutcomes: Deal with most situations when they travel in places where people speak English
Talk about experiences and events, dreams, hopes and ambitions, give reasons and explanations for opinions and plans, tell the story of a book or film and describe reactions

Understand the main points of a clear speech on work, school and leisure, understand the main point on many radio or TV programs on current affairs or familiar topics, when the speaker speaks slowly and clearly
Write simply about familiar topics, write personal letters describing experiences and impressions

englishCourses.Description: This course is for learners who have completed level 3 or have reached this level in another set-up. (The learner will sit a test to determine his or her level)
LearningOutcomes: Speak regularly with any English speakers
Discuss familiar topics in detail and give their opinions and explain advantages and disadvantages

Understand long speeches and lectures and follow complex arguments if the topic is reasonably familiar, understand most TV news and current affairs programs and the majority of films in common accents
Read articles and reports about common topics and understand modern novels
Write clearly and in detail about a wide range of subjects, including essays, reports and letters about events and personal experiences

englishCourses.Description: This course is for learners who have completed level 4 or have reached this level in another set-up. (The learner will have to sit for a test to determine his or her level)
LearningOutcomes: Speak fluently without searching for language
Give ideas and opinions and relate their ideas to those of other speakers
Talk about complex subjects and develop arguments
Understand long complex speech
Understand most television programs and films
Understand long and complex factual literary texts, with different styles
Understand specialized articles and long technical instructions
Write long, clear, well-structured text to express their points of view
Write about complex subject in a letter, an essay or a report
Write in an appropriate style

englishCourses.Description: This course is for learners who have completed level 5 or have reached this level in another set-up. (The learner will have to sit for a test to determine his or her level)
LearningOutcomes: Take part fluently and effortlessly in any conversation and have a good familiarity with idiomatic expressions and colloquialisms
Present a clear, smoothly-flowing description or argument in a style appropriate to the context and with an effective logical structure
Understand any kind of spoken language, live or broadcast, at fast native speed when the learner has some time to get familiar with different accent
Read with ease abstract structurally or linguistically complex texts such as manuals, specialized articles and literary works
Write clear, smoothly flowing texts in an appropriate style
Write complex letters, reports or articles which present a case with an effective logical structure
Write summaries and reviews of professional or literary works
